inputs.original_text: The measures follow the passage of Bill C-12, also known as the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, which received royal assent on March 26, 2026. The post Canada tightens immigration, asylum rules against Nigerians, others appeared first on Vanguard News .
inputs.modified_text: They’re presenting the measures as routine border policy, but the timing points to a coordinated tightening after Bill C-12 received royal assent on March 26, 2026. The headline says Nigerians and others are in the crosshairs; the reassuring language around “strengthening” the system looks like a way to sell a broader clampdown while obscuring who benefits from it.
